title: Content Writer
company: ROSE & YOUNG RECRUITMENT LTD - Agency - Permanent
description:
Content Writer/Marketing Content Specialist - Manufacturing

Rugby

£40,000 - £45,000 per annum

Potential hybrid after completion of probationary period - must be local to Rugby.

Our client is looking for a Creative Content Writer to join their Rugby team and help make complex product information clear, accurate and easy to use.

You will work closely with Engineering, Design and other business teams to create andimprove manuals, brochures, catalogues, installation guides, maintenance information and product documentation. This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys organising information, improving standards and producing polished, user-friendly content.

Duties:
- Create and update operation manuals, catalogues, brochures, installation guides, maintenance instructions and product information.For Marketing purposes.
- Turn engineering drawings, specifications and technical input into clear, easy-to-follow content.
- Work with engineers, designers, product specialists, and marketing to confirm information and maintain accuracy.
- Manage document revisions, templates, file structures and controlled documentation libraries.
- Create or coordinate product images, diagrams and technical illustrations.
- Support departments to help improve the consistency, quality and usability of documents.

Essential:
- Experience creating technical documents, manuals, instructions, brochures, catalogues or similarly structured content.
- Strong written English and the ability to explain technical information clearly.
- Excellent attention to detail, organisation and document presentation.
- Strong Microsoft Word skills and confidence working with standard Microsoft Office applications.
- A collaborative approach and the confidence to gather information from technical colleagues.

Desirable:
- Experience in manufacturing, engineering, equipment or another technical product environment.
- Experience with document control, revision management or compliance documentation.
- Ability to read CAD drawings.
- Experience with Adobe InDesign, Illustrator or similar publishing and graphics software.

title: Marketing Assistant
company: Morris Clarke Recruitment Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Experienced Marketing Assistant required to work for a prestigious Client based in Rugby.

Main Purpose of Job

To support the marketing strategy providing marketing support services in respect of the Company s prospects and customers.

Main Activities

1. Assist in building and maintaining a prospecting database and a customer database.

2. Maintain records relating to prospects and customers.

3. Maintain and foster good relations with prospects and customers through multi-marketing channels including but not exclusively; telephone, social media, email, e-shot and mail.

4. Gain valuable market intelligence to support Direct Marketing Unit team.

5. Support Managers and Sales Executives in administration duties as part of the Company s marketing strategy.

6. Provide information and feedback on marketing activities undertaken informing the direction of future campaign activity.

7. Organise, contribute towards the generation of and send social media post, communications and e-shots.

8. Carry out effective market research.

9. To adhere to all policies, procedures and codes of conduct as issued by the Company.

10. To be responsible for generating leads amongst prospects for Sales Executives aligned to Key Performance Indicators.

11. To support the organisation of marketing strategies to ensure business growth in line with the company objectives.

12. To support the Sales Executives in building long term relationships and trust amongst all of the company s customers.

Main Outcomes

1. To ensure the Company Prospect and Customer database is accurate and up to date.

2. Maintain and improve good customer relations.

3. Produce accurate and timely reports on marketing activities.

4. Complete accurate and timely marketing to a schedule of activities.

Ideal candiate will have experience of working in a busy Marketing Team, be computer literate and familiar with social media, have an excellent telephone manner and be happy to call customers in order to look after existing customers and gain new ones.

You will have accurate keyboard skills, be an active team player and be able to work on own initiative.

Hours of work ar Mon to Thurs 9am to 5pm

Fri 9am to 430pm

£7 hours per week

title: Office Administrator with Communications and Stewardship
company: Friends of the Holy Land - Agency - Permanent
description:
Do you have a way with words and an eye for a good story? We're looking for someone who can help people across the UK get to know the Christian communities we support in Palestine, Jordan and Israel and inspire more people to get involved.

You will work alongside our Operations Manager and the small office team to keep our charity running smoothly. You will also work with our Head of Communications, helping turn news from Bethlehem into stories for our website, put together supporter emails and look after our social media channels. You will get to know our supporters by phone, whether you're thanking a parish for its generosity or talking with someone considering a gift in their Will.

After you've been with us for 6 months we'll arrange a visit to the Holy Land so you can see the work first-hand.

You will need to be comfortable working in a faith-based organisation, making calls and talking to supporters and clergy across the UK and with our partners in the Holy Land.

If this sounds like something you'd enjoy and thrive at, please click on 'Apply Now' to download the full job specification and description.

title: Senior Marketing Executive
description:
Senior Marketing Executive

IT Networking & Security

Ideal Candidate Location - 1 hour of Coventry - Hybrid Working

Birmingham, Coventry, Northampton, Leicester, Rugby, Stratford, Warwick

Up to £48,000 Basic Salary + Bonus + Other benefits
- Are you a full mix B2 B marketing professional with experience working in a technical field?
- Do you have hands on experience in campaign management, content production, website maintenance & development, AI leveraged marketing operations?
- Are you keen to work for a fantastic company that is going through a period of renewal and expansion?
- Do you enjoy lead generation marketing and being rewarded for the ROI you help generate?

If you can answer yes to the above, this is a role for you!
Our client is looking for a driven Senior Marketing Executive who wants to get hands-on and really get stuck into this brilliant company's digital revamp.

Your Role as a Senior Marketing Executive:
- A hands-on role in a small marketing team, where most of the marketing output is produced in-house rather than via agency.
- Responsible for producing content and materials: web content, sales and customer collateral, case studies, web news stories, customer newsletters, factsheets and product release notes for direct and channel sales.
- Responsible for keeping product manuals, FAQs and other customer-facing technical content current and fit for purpose.
- Responsible for managing and extending integrated direct marketing campaigns: building contact lists, defining message sets, producing and automating campaign messages and workflows, and analysing performance. You will be accountable for the quantity and quality of leads generated.
- Responsible for the ongoing maintenance and development of the company's websites and microsites, including content publishing via WordPress and AI-supported HTML/CSS/JS, ongoing design improvement, SEO, PPC optimisation and LLM citation strategy. Web leads are the key route to the company's growth objectives.
- Responsible for building and maintaining a library of AI tools and workflows that multiply the team's output, such as writing and design engines, research tools, campaign generators and performance analysis. This is expected to be a significant differentiator in the role.
- Monitoring, analysing and reporting on campaign, website and content performance, using the data to improve lead generation, conversion rates, content effectiveness and sales support.
- Contributing to social media campaigns and to the overall direction of the web presence, with scope to take on more of this responsibility over time.
- Contributing to product strategy and product management, including analysis of market segments, geographies, pricing, channels and technologies, and developing tactical plans to position the products.
- On a more occasional basis: major content projects for new products and market initiatives, advanced animated sales presentations and webinar material, and material supporting partner marketing, PR, lobbying, advocacy and events.
- Working as part of the company's senior team. In the short term, you are likely to become either the strong number two to the marketing lead or the lead yourself.

Ideal Background for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- 3 years+ B2 B marketing experience with technical products and or services. Ideally in the IT / Technology market.
- Demonstrable hands-on use of AI in marketing; not occasional drafting, but specific examples of tools or workflows you have built and what they changed.
- A fluent copywriter with a solid portfolio, able to quickly absorb a technical proposition and turn it into clear, impactful messaging.
- Real expertise in one or more of copywriting, graphic design and digital marketing, with solid skills across the wider marketing mix.
- A proven ability to contribute to marketing strategy, with a track record of measurable campaign success.
- A rigorous, structured and data-driven approach to complex problems, including drawing well-judged conclusions from market assessments. This is likely, but not necessarily, backed by a strong degree.
- Highly organised and self-sufficient, bringing your own process and discipline, with a track record of delivering on commitments.
- A direct, confident communicator, written and verbal, who says what they think, backs it up and can deliver uncomfortable information clearly.
- A strong team player with the drive, energy and tenacity to thrive in an entrepreneurial SME rather than a large corporate environment.
- Right to work in the UK without sponsorship.

The Company recruiting for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- A UK-headquartered technology company developing specialist IT products for niche technical markets.
- Established for over 20 years, with customers in over 150 countries; more than 90% of sales are outside Europe, with the USA a key market.
- Their flagship product is the world leader in its niche, with significant growth opportunities in education and other high-value sectors worldwide.
- Run as a true marketing-led business, with a CEO who has vast experience in B2 B strategic marketing.
- Going through an exciting period of renewal and expansion, including new ventures in edtech and AI-driven business automation.
- A proven track record of developing people quickly and rewarding outstanding performance.

The Package for the Senior Marketing Executive:
- Up to £48,000 Basic Salary
- Half-Yearly Performance Bonus
- Hybrid Working
- Pension Scheme
- Clear Career Progression into Marketing Leadership
- Additional Company Benefits

Please apply for this job online if you are interested and feel you fit the above criteria.
John Ahearne is the main point of contact for the role.

title: Senior Marketing Executive (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)
description:
Senior Marketing Executive (12-Month Fixed-Term Contract)

Salary: £45,000 - £50,000 (depending on experience)

Hours: Full-Time, Monday to Friday, 7:30am - 4:30pm (4 days pw in the office / 1 day pw from home)

Location: Leamington Spa

Benefits:
- Bonus scheme
- 22 days holiday plus Bank Holidays
- Free breakfast, lunch, refreshments and snacks
- Employee reward and recognition programme
- On-site parking, with access to free EV charging points
- Potential use of a pool car/car allowance
- Work within a global organisation operating across 19 countries

Senior Marketing Coordinator - 12-Month FTC

Are you an organised, commercially minded marketer who enjoys owning the marketing for multiple product lines and seeing campaigns through from brief to results?

This is an exciting opportunity to join Universal Business Team (UBT) as a Senior Marketing Coordinator on a 12-month maternity cover contract. As a global organisation supporting over 3,000 family businesses across 19 countries, UBT is passionate about helping businesses grow, innovate, and achieve long-term success.

Reporting to the Northern Hemisphere Marketing Lead, you will own the UK marketing for one of UBT's product lines. You will plan and deliver campaigns that drive lead generation and brand awareness, and you will be the main marketing contact for the product's internal owners. You will join a small UK marketing team within a fast-paced, values-driven international organisation. Internally, the role carries the UBT title of Senior Marketing Coordinator.

About the Opportunity

You'll be responsible for supporting several business divisions, helping to create and execute strategic marketing initiatives that generate engagement, strengthen market presence, and contribute towards commercial objectives.

Key responsibilities include:
- Owning the UK marketing plan and campaign calendar for multiple product lines, aligned to its commercial objectives
- Planning and delivering campaigns that increase awareness and generate leads, from brief to results
- Building, testing and reporting on email and nurture campaigns in Marketo
- Reviewing and quality-checking regular client email bulletins before they are sent
- Create engaging content and marketing assets across multiple channels
- Coordinating stakeholders and obtaining sign-off for marketing activities
- Working closely with internal departments to understand business objectives and maximise campaign effectiveness
- Leading meetings, presenting ideas, and providing marketing recommendations to revenue teams
- Monitoring campaign performance and recommending improvements
- Supporting product launches, events, and wider business initiatives

About You

To be successful, you'll bring a combination of strong marketing expertise, commercial awareness, and excellent organisational skills.

You'll ideally have:
- At least 3 years' marketing experience within a B2 B, professional services, corporate, or commercial environment
- Experience owning the marketing for a product, service or business line, from plan through to results
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Strong project management and organisational abilities
- Hands-on experience with Marketo or a similar marketing automation platform
- The ability to get up to speed quickly and deliver within your first few weeks
- The ability to manage multiple campaigns and competing priorities simultaneously
- Experience engaging with stakeholders at all levels of a business
- A proactive, positive and solutions-focused approach
- A keen eye for detail and high standards of execution
- The confidence to present ideas and influence decision-making
- A degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related discipline (desirable)

If you're looking for a role that offers ownership, variety, and the opportunity to deliver meaningful marketing campaigns within a dynamic international business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more

IND25

title: Trainee Digital Marketing Manager No experience needed (Ref: 6901)
description:
DIGITAL MARKETING TRAINEESHIP (REMOTE)

Become a Digital Marketing Professional and Build Real-World Experience

Are you interested in digital marketing, online business, and helping organisations grow through effective marketing strategies? Do you want to gain practical experience while developing skills that employers are actively looking for?

We are offering a Digital Marketing Traineeship designed to help aspiring digital marketers develop industry-relevant knowledge through structured learning and practical projects.

What You Will Learn

Throughout the traineeship, you will develop an understanding of:
- Digital Marketing Fundamentals
- Marketing Strategy and Planning
- Search Engine Optimisation (SEO)
- Pay-Per-Click (PPC) Advertising
- Social Media Marketing
- Content Marketing
- Email Marketing
- Google Analytics and Marketing Analytics
- Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO)
- Customer Journey Mapping
- Branding and Positioning
- Market Research and Competitor Analysis
- Artificial Intelligence (AI) for Marketing
- Marketing Automation
- Campaign Planning and Performance Measurement
- Marketing Reporting and Data Analysis

Practical Experience

You will work on realistic marketing projects that may include:
- Developing digital marketing strategies
- SEO audits and optimisation recommendations
- Social media campaign planning
- Content creation and marketing calendars
- Email marketing campaigns
- Marketing analytics and reporting
- Website optimisation projects
- Competitor research
- Brand positioning exercises
- Portfolio projects demonstrating your marketing skills

This practical experience will help you develop a professional portfolio that demonstrates your capabilities to future employers.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for individuals who:
- Have an interest in marketing, business, and technology
- Enjoy analysing data and solving problems
- Have good communication skills
- Are creative and eager to learn
- Can work independently and manage their time effectively
- Have basic computer skills

No previous digital marketing experience is required. Successful applicants will undertake our paid Digital Marketing training programme before progressing into employment. The cost of the training is the responsibility of the learner, and full guidance and support will be provided throughout the programme.

Benefits
- Remote and flexible learning
- Industry-relevant curriculum
- Portfolio development opportunities
- Practical project experience
- Mentoring and personalised feedback
- Career guidance and employability support
- Opportunity to develop skills sought by modern employers

Entry Requirements
- A good level of written English
- Access to a computer and internet connection
- Motivation to learn and develop professionally

Career Opportunities

Upon successful completion, learners may pursue roles such as:
- Digital Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Specialist
- SEO Executive
- PPC Executive
- Content Marketing Executive
- Social Media Executive
- Email Marketing Executive
- Marketing Coordinator
- Marketing Analyst
- Growth Marketing Executive
- Performance Marketing Executive
- Digital Marketing Assistant

Apply Today

If you are looking to start a career in Digital Marketing and want to gain practical experience while developing a professional portfolio, we would love to hear from you.

Submit your application today and begin your journey towards a career in one of the world's fastest-growing industries.

We advertise this role across multiple UK locations - you only need to apply once and you'll be considered for all of them.
